_note: THE INDUSTRIAL FAMILY, 3 OF 10: THE FIRE.
There was a fire, the owners claimed for it, and the insurer does not believe them. Read the three places it
started, in any order, and take the device that started it. The verb is PROVE, and the answer is unkind to the
client's client: the evidence says the owners set it.
Industrial dungeons (LocTypeDungeon_ThemeIndustrial, 20 per Eliza's count), vanilla interiors that carry the
delve markers today. Every word holds in any of them: nothing names the site, the faction or what the plant
made; everything a line points at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

prose.name: Survey: Fire at the Works on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The owners of the <Place> claimed for a fire. The insurer thinks somebody set it, and wants proof either way.
prose.card: Insurance Contract. Find where the fire at the <Place> on <Planet> started. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: One place the fire started: a junction box burned from the inside out, which is not how junction boxes usually burn.
beats.name: Scorched Junction Box

beats.journal: One place the fire started: a locker that burned hot and alone, with nothing near it to catch.
beats.name: Burned Locker

beats.journal: One place the fire started: the terminal's log ends four minutes before the alarm, on a command that switched the alarm off.
beats.name: Scorched Terminal

beats.journal: Three places the fire started, all at once, and a timer with the owners' work order number scratched on it. The insurer was right.
beats.name: Sealed Evidence Case

message.title: Ignition Timer
message.text: A cheap timer, the kind you buy by the dozen. Somebody scratched a work order number on the back, out of habit, so the job could be billed.

say: A timer with their own work order on it. That's all the proof the claim needs.

broadcast: Fire like that doesn't start in one place. Find all of them. And if there's anything that looks like it was put there, bring it to me.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Recast 2026-10-26 from Katie X (ruled out by his ear) to Annie K, one of the two voices heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
